name: Brittany

attributes.attribute: an ancient Celtic land now forming much of France
a land brought under Roman rule

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brittany is a cross-reference in this book. It points the reader to GAUL. Gaul was an ancient Celtic land. That land now forms much of modern France. Rome brought it under its rule. The Gallic tribes shared a common language.
